## Overview

The DARKSCO Pro Ableton Live Pack is an ultra-complete, professional music production environment delivered as a `.als` Live Set. It includes:

- **Drum Rack** with 6 velocity-layered pads (Kick, Snare, Hihat, Open Hat, Clap, Perc)
- **Melodic MidiTracks** wrapped in **Instrument Racks** with 8 easy macro controls each
- **MIDI Effects** (Scale tool + Arpeggiator) for constrained, performance-ready input
- **Wavetable synth layers** as performance alternatives running parallel to Simplers
- **Organized Track Groups** (Drums, Melodic Stems, FX Returns) for clean mixer hierarchy
- **Professional Return Tracks** (Reverb A, Delay B) with pre-baked send amounts
- **Master chain** (EQ + Glue Compressor + Limiter) for club-safe delivery

Everything is built with native Ableton devices only — no third-party plugins.

## Track Architecture

### Hierarchy
```
[Drums GroupTrack] ─ Orange
  └─ DrumRack (6 pads, 3 velocity layers each)
     └─ Post-chain: Drum Bus EQ → Glue Compressor → Limiter

[Melodic Stems GroupTrack] ─ Teal
  ├─ Bass (MidiTrack) ─ Scale tool → Simpler+Rack → FX chain → Sends
  ├─ Bass (WT) (MidiTrack) ─ Wavetable synth alt-layer
  ├─ Pad (MidiTrack) ─ Scale tool → Simpler+Rack → FX chain → Sends
  ├─ Pad (WT) (MidiTrack) ─ Wavetable alt-layer
  ├─ Stab (MidiTrack) ─ Scale tool → Simpler+Rack → FX chain → Sends
  ├─ Stab (WT) (MidiTrack) ─ Wavetable alt-layer
  ├─ Arp (MidiTrack) ─ Arpeggiator → Simpler+Rack → FX chain → Sends
  └─ Arp (WT) (MidiTrack) ─ Wavetable alt-layer with Arpeggiator

[Master Mix AudioTrack] ─ Green
  └─ Full-length stereo mix reference (WAV clip)

[FX Returns GroupTrack] ─ White
  ├─ Return A — Reverb ─ EQ (HP+LP pre-verb) → Reverb (2.4s decay, Size 0.75)
  └─ Return B — Delay ─ EQ (HP+LP pre-delay) → Delay (1/8L+3/8R, 30% FB)

[Master Track]
  └─ EQ Eight → Glue Compressor → Limiter (-0.3dBTP)
```

## Instrument Racks — 8 Macro Control Map

Each melodic stem (Bass, Pad, Stab, Arp) is wrapped in an **Ableton Instrument Rack** with 8 pre-assigned macro controls:

| Macro | Name | Range | Default | Purpose |
|-------|------|-------|---------|---------|
| 1 | Filter Freq | 100 Hz → 20 kHz | 8 kHz | Cutoff frequency sweep |
| 2 | Filter Res | 0 → 1 | 0.5 | Filter resonance / emphasis |
| 3 | Saturation | 0 → 40 | 0 | Drive / harmonic distortion |
| 4 | Reverb Send | 0 → 1 | 0.35 (Pad) / varies | Send to Return A (Reverb) |
| 5 | Delay Send | 0 → 1 | 0.15 (Pad) / varies | Send to Return B (Delay) |
| 6 | Volume | 0 → 2 | 1.0 | Track output gain |
| 7 | Panorama | −1 → 1 | 0 | Left/right panning |
| 8 | Effect Wet/Dry | 0 → 1 | 0.5 | Post-effect blend |

All macros are **automatable** and **MIDI-mappable** for live performance control.

## MIDI Effects

### Scale Tool
- **Placement**: Before Simpler on Bass, Pad, Stab tracks
- **Configuration**: Project key (C Major) with Fold enabled
- **Behavior**: Constrains played notes to the project key, snapping to valid scale degrees
- **Performance**: Improvisation-safe — can't play wrong notes

### Arpeggiator
- **Placement**: Before Simpler/Wavetable on Arp track
- **Configuration**: Up mode, 1/8 beat rate, 1 octave range
- **Behavior**: Plays held notes in upward succession at synced rhythm
- **Performance**: Turn on/off for instant rhythmic gate effects

---

## Wavetable Alternative Layers

Each melodic stem has a **parallel Wavetable synth track** for performance depth and synthesis control:

| Track | MIDI Effects | Volume | Send Levels | Use Case |
|-------|--------------|--------|-------------|----------|
| Bass (WT) | Scale tool | −3dB | 80% of Simpler sends | Sync sub layer with harmonic complexity |
| Pad (WT) | Scale tool | −3dB | 80% of Simpler sends | Pad thickness; twin-pad ensemble |
| Stab (WT) | Scale tool | −3dB | 80% of Simpler sends | Stab harmonics; piercing edge |
| Arp (WT) | Arpeggiator | −3dB | 80% of Simpler sends | Rhythmic texture; synth melody |

Each Wavetable:
- Uses **Init Osc** (default wavetable)
- Has basic **LP filter** (500 Hz cutoff, 0.4 resonance)
- Includes **ADSR envelope** (5ms attack, 100ms decay, 80% sustain, 500ms release)
- Routes to **same mixer** as Simpler (enables blend via volume)

## Pre-Baked FX Chains

### Bass Track FX
```
Simpler (12-zone) 
  → Saturator (Analog mode, Drive 4, 70% wet)
  → EQ Eight (HP 30Hz, Sub shelf +2.5dB @ 60Hz, Mud cut −2dB @ 300Hz, Upper +1.5dB @ 1.2kHz, LP roll @ 8kHz)
  → Glue Compressor (−14dB threshold, 2:1 ratio, 3ms attack, auto release, 1dB makeup)
  → Utility (Mono below 120Hz for club tight bass)
```

### Pad Track FX
```
Simpler (10-zone)
  → EQ Eight (HP 80Hz, Mud cut @ 500Hz, Presence +1.5dB @ 3kHz, Air shelf +2dB @ 12kHz)
  → Compressor (−16dB, 2:1, 20ms attack, 300ms release, 8dB knee, 1dB makeup)
  → Chorus-Ensemble (Ensemble mode, 35% amount, 45% wet/dry)
  → Utility (−1.5dB gain trim for headroom)
```

### Stab Track FX
```
Simpler (10-zone)
  → EQ Eight (HP 120Hz, Mid bite +2dB @ 800Hz, Top brightness +1.5dB @ 4kHz, Harshness cut @ 16kHz)
  → Saturator (Analog mode, Drive 6, 60% wet)
  → Compressor (−10dB, 4:1, 2ms attack, 50ms release, 3dB knee, 2dB makeup)
  → Utility (90% stereo width)
```

### Arp Track FX
```
Simpler (10-zone)
  → EQ Eight (HP 100Hz, Low-mid clean @ 600Hz, Sparkle +2dB @ 2.5kHz, Air +1.5dB @ 10kHz)
  → Compressor (−12dB, 3:1, 5ms attack, 80ms release, 4dB knee, 1dB makeup)
  → Utility (neutral gain/width)
```

### Drum Rack Post-Chain (Drum Bus)
```
DrumRack
  → EQ Eight (HP 40Hz, Low shelf +1.5dB @ 60Hz, Mud cut −1dB @ 200Hz, Presence +1.2dB @ 3.5kHz, Rolloff @ 12kHz)
  → Glue Compressor (−8dB, 4:1, 1ms attack, auto release, 2dB makeup, 80% wet/dry)
  → Limiter (−0.5dBTP, 1.0s lookahead)
```

### Master Track
```
EQ Eight (Low shelf +1.5dB @ 60Hz, Mud cut −1dB @ 200Hz, Air shelf +0.8dB @ 8kHz)
  → Glue Compressor (−6dB, 2:1, 2ms attack, auto release, 1dB makeup, 70% wet)
  → Limiter (−0.3dBTP brick-wall ceiling, 1.0s lookahead)
```

## Return Tracks & Send Routing

### Return A — Reverb
- **EQ**: HP 120Hz + LP 8kHz (pre-reverb)
- **Device**: Reverb (native)
  - Room Size: 0.75
  - Decay Time: 2.4 sec
  - Pre-Delay: 15ms
  - Diffusion: 90%
  - Wet: 100%, Dry: 0%

**Pre-baked Send Amounts**:
- Bass: 0% (stays dry)
- Pad: 35% (lush reverb)
- Stab: 15% (light space)
- Arp: 10% (subtle ambient)

### Return B — Delay
- **EQ**: HP 200Hz + LP 8kHz (pre-delay)
- **Device**: Delay (native)
  - Left delay: 1/8 beat
  - Right delay: 3/8 beat (dotted quarter)
  - Feedback: 30%
  - Filter: Bandpass (200 Hz – 8 kHz)
  - Wet: 85%, Dry: 15%

**Pre-baked Send Amounts**:
- Bass: 0% (stays dry)
- Pad: 15% (rhythmic depth)
- Stab: 20% (syncopation)
- Arp: 30% (prominent echo)

## Drum Rack Details

### Pad Configuration
Each drum pad uses:
- **3 Velocity Layers** per sample (soft, medium, hard)
- **Velocity Range Mapping**:
  - Soft: 1–60
  - Medium: 61–100
  - Hard: 101–127

### Per-Pad FX Chain

| Pad | EQ Profile | Compressor Settings | Role |
|-----|------------|-------------------|------|
| **Kick** (C1) | Sub +3dB, Click +2.5dB @ 4kHz | 3:1, −12dB, 3ms A, 60ms R | Foundation; deep sub with punch |
| **Snare** (D1) | Body @ 200Hz, Crack @ 5kHz, Air | 4:1, −14dB, 5ms A, 80ms R | Transient snap; presence |
| **Hihat** (F#1) | HP 600Hz, Air shelf | 2:1, −20dB, 2ms A, 30ms R | Brightness; controlled cymbals |
| **Open Hat** (A#1) | HP 800Hz, Shimmer @ 8kHz | 2:1, −18dB, 5ms A, 200ms R | Sizzle; long decay |
| **Clap** (E1) | Slap body @ 1kHz, Crack @ 7kHz | 3:1, −16dB, 4ms A, 70ms R | Impact; mid-range slap |
| **Perc** (G#1) | Metallic @ 2.5kHz | 2:1, −18dB, 3ms A, 60ms R | Texture; rhythmic punctuation |

## Live Play Workflow

### Immediate Performance Setup
1. Open `.als` in Ableton Live 11 or 12
2. Arm each melodic MidiTrack for input
3. Use **Scale tool** to constrain pitch (can't play "wrong" notes)
4. Use **8 Rack Macros** for filter sweeps, saturation, reverb/delay blending
5. Toggle **Arpeggiator** on Arp track for instant rhythmic gating
6. Blend **Simpler + Wavetable** tracks via volume for texture variety

### Send Amounts (Pre-Baked)
- No adjustment needed; reverb/delay sends are pre-balanced
- Use **Return Track volume** to control overall space depth
- Use **Master Limiter** ceiling for club safety (−0.3dBTP)

### Performance Macros (Real-Time Tweaks)
- **Macro 1–2**: Open/close filter for energy builds
- **Macro 3**: Increase saturation for intensity
- **Macro 4–5**: Blend reverb/delay for spatial effects
- **Macro 6–8**: Volume trim, panorama, effect mix

## Export & Usage

### Downloading the Pack
1. Generate DARKSCO stems via `/stem-generator` page
2. Click **Export Ableton Pack** button
3. ZIP downloads with all contents:
   ```
   DARKSCO_Night_120bpm.zip
   ├── DARKSCO_Night_120bpm.als (Ableton Live set)
   ├── Samples/Originals/
   │   ├── kick.wav, snare.wav, ... (7 stems)
   │   └── master_mix.wav
   ├── MIDI Clips/ (7 MIDI files, Format 0, 480 PPQ)
   └── README.txt
   ```

### Opening in Ableton Live
1. Unzip anywhere on your machine
2. Double-click `.als` file → opens in Ableton Live 11+
3. All samples auto-resolve to relative paths in ZIP
4. Starts with Drums playing; melodic tracks ready for MIDI input

### Live Performance
- Arm melodic MidiTracks
- Input MIDI via keyboard/controller
- Scale tool constrains pitch
- 8 Rack Macros + Wavetable blend = infinite sound variations
- Pre-baked reverb/delay sends require no setup
